source_text: It’s quite a beautiful church you have here.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp>.It’s quite a beautiful church you have here.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp>.It’s quite a beautiful church you have here."

translation: Macie naprawdę piękny kościół.

source_text: Have you never visited?

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Have you never visited?
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Have you never visited?"

translation: Nigdy tu nie byłaś?

source_text: Catholicism isn’t quite my religion of choice.

structure.raw_value: MeFlDe>.Catholicism isn’t quite my religion of choice.
structure.script_literal: "MeFlDe>.Catholicism isn’t quite my religion of choice."

translation: Katolicyzm nie jest moją religią.

source_text: Oh, yes. Of course.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Oh, yes. Of course.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Oh, yes. Of course."

translation: Ach, tak. Oczywiście.

source_text: Is Father Solomon here?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Is Father Solomon here?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Is Father Solomon here?"

translation: Czy ojciec Solomon jest na miejscu?

source_text: He’s away. We have a roof repair that we’re working on.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.He’s away. We have a roof repair that we’re working on.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.He’s away. We have a roof repair that we’re working on."

translation: Nie ma go. Zajmujemy się naprawą dachu.

source_text: Can we see Father Zephaniah’s old quarters?

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp>.Can we see Father Zephaniah’s old quarters?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp>.Can we see Father Zephaniah’s old quarters?"

translation: Możemy zobaczyć dawną kwaterę ojca Zephaniaha?

source_text: I’m afraid that is where Father Solomon sleeps now, and he locks it while he is away.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.I’m afraid that is where Father Solomon sleeps now, and he locks it while he is away.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.I’m afraid that is where Father Solomon sleeps now, and he locks it while he is away."

translation: Obawiam się, że teraz śpi tam ojciec Solomon i zamyka pokój, gdy wychodzi.

source_text: We can wait…

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp>.We can wait…
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp>.We can wait…"

translation: Możemy poczekać…

source_text: In the meantime, can we check the other areas?

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx>.In the meantime, can we check the other areas?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx>.In the meantime, can we check the other areas?"

translation: W międzyczasie możemy obejrzeć pozostałe pomieszczenia?

source_text: Of course. And if there’s anything you need from me, please do ask.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Of course. And if there’s anything you need from me, please do ask.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Of course. And if there’s anything you need from me, please do ask."

translation: Oczywiście. Jeśli będziecie czegoś potrzebować, śmiało pytajcie.

source_text: Is this the chapel?

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp>.Is this the chapel?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp>.Is this the chapel?"

translation: To kaplica?

source_text: Yes, and there is a storage area and attic access there as well.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.Yes, and there is a storage area and attic access there as well.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.Yes, and there is a storage area and attic access there as well."

translation: Tak. Jest tam też schowek i wejście na strych.

source_text: Thank you, Sister Judy…

structure.raw_value: MeFrOp>.Thank you, Sister Judy…
structure.script_literal: "MeFrOp>.Thank you, Sister Judy…"

translation: Dziękuję, siostro Judy…

source_text: 1Hero, let’s start searching. We’re looking for a prescription bottle.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx>.1Hero, let’s start searching. We’re looking for a prescription bottle.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx>.1Hero, let’s start searching. We’re looking for a prescription bottle."

translation: 1Hero, zaczynajmy poszukiwania. Szukamy fiolki po lekach na receptę.

source_text: Oh, my. Something like that may have been thrown away.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Oh, my. Something like that may have been thrown away.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Oh, my. Something like that may have been thrown away."

translation: Ojej. Coś takiego mogło zostać wyrzucone.

source_text: The police would have seized it when they came. Hopefully, if it’s here, it has remained overlooked.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp>.The police would have seized it when they came. Hopefully, if it’s here, it has remained overlooked.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp>.The police would have seized it when they came. Hopefully, if it’s here, it has remained overlooked."

translation: Policja pewnie zabrała ją podczas przeszukania. Jeśli jednak nadal tu jest, może nikt jej nie zauważył.

source_text: If I had to guess, Madalyn’s murder spree may have taken Father Zephaniah.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.If I had to guess, Madalyn’s murder spree may have taken Father Zephaniah.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.If I had to guess, Madalyn’s murder spree may have taken Father Zephaniah."

translation: Zgaduję, że ojciec Zephaniah mógł paść ofiarą morderczej serii Madalyn.

source_text: My goodness! It’s so hard to believe that I have been close to such a woman.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.My goodness! It’s so hard to believe that I have been close to such a woman.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.My goodness! It’s so hard to believe that I have been close to such a woman."

translation: Mój Boże! Trudno uwierzyć, że znałam taką kobietę.

source_text: I do hope that you’re able to find what you need.

structure.raw_value: JuSaCl.I do hope that you’re able to find what you need.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaCl.I do hope that you’re able to find what you need."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że uda wam się znaleźć to, czego szukacie.

source_text: If you need me, I’ll be checking on our leak. It seems to have gotten worse.

structure.raw_value: JuBaEx.If you need me, I’ll be checking on our leak. It seems to have gotten worse.
structure.script_literal: "JuBaEx.If you need me, I’ll be checking on our leak. It seems to have gotten worse."

translation: Gdybyście mnie potrzebowali, sprawdzę przeciek. Chyba się powiększył.

source_text: Hopefully Father Solomon can fix it before it starts to rain.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Hopefully Father Solomon can fix it before it starts to rain.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Hopefully Father Solomon can fix it before it starts to rain."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że ojciec Solomon naprawi go, zanim zacznie padać.

source_text: I don’t have high hopes. It’s been leaking for weeks.

structure.raw_value: JuSaCl.I don’t have high hopes. It’s been leaking for weeks.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaCl.I don’t have high hopes. It’s been leaking for weeks."

translation: Nie liczę na wiele. Dach przecieka już od tygodni.

source_text: Maybe I can lend a hand.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Maybe I can lend a hand.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Maybe I can lend a hand."

translation: Może mógłbym pomóc.

source_text: Father should be back shortly.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.Father should be back shortly.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.Father should be back shortly."

translation: Ojciec powinien niedługo wrócić.

source_text: Carol and Mom are messing with that truck of hers. I didn’t want to hang around and hear their gossip talk.

structure.raw_value: ChFlEx.Carol and Mom are messing with that truck of hers. I didn’t want to hang around and hear their gossip talk.
structure.script_literal: "ChFlEx.Carol and Mom are messing with that truck of hers. I didn’t want to hang around and hear their gossip talk."

translation: Carol i mama grzebią przy jej ciężarówce. Nie chciałam tam siedzieć i słuchać ich plotek.

source_text: Haha. I understand.

structure.raw_value: McFlOpNo4.Haha. I understand.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOpNo4.Haha. I understand."

translation: Haha. Rozumiem.

source_text: My boss has me investigating another crime.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.My boss has me investigating another crime.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.My boss has me investigating another crime."

translation: Szef przydzielił mi kolejne śledztwo.

source_text: Here at the church?

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.Here at the church?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.Here at the church?"

translation: Tutaj, w kościele?

source_text: Seems the old priest may have been murdered by Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Seems the old priest may have been murdered by Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Seems the old priest may have been murdered by Madalyn."

translation: Wygląda na to, że Madalyn mogła zamordować starego księdza.

source_text: No way! Where is Judy? Is she safe?

structure.raw_value: ChWoClNo1.No way! Where is Judy? Is she safe?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoClNo1.No way! Where is Judy? Is she safe?"

translation: Niemożliwe! Gdzie jest Judy? Nic jej nie jest?

source_text: She’s fine. She’s upstairs checking on a leak.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.She’s fine. She’s upstairs checking on a leak.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.She’s fine. She’s upstairs checking on a leak."

translation: Wszystko z nią dobrze. Jest na górze i sprawdza przeciek.

source_text: Thanks. I’m going to go talk to her.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.Thanks. I’m going to go talk to her.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.Thanks. I’m going to go talk to her."

translation: Dzięki. Pójdę z nią porozmawiać.

source_text: I better get back to work.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I better get back to work.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I better get back to work. "

translation: Lepiej wrócę do pracy.
